If you're nervous, I'll hold your hand for you.

No matter how much you say you don't want to go, I'll drag you there by force if I have to.
That's right...
I'll carry you there in my arms if I have to.
Would you like that better?
............No?
I see...{p}
rows.56:2cdc:
It's all right.
You don't have to deny it in such a hurry.
{b}...
You think there aren't any ghosts in a place like this.
I can tell the moment I look at your face.{p}
rows.56:2d7c:

rows.56:2dd0:
"Oh! So you'll open it.
{b}, you've finally made up your mind...

What in the world could be inside...★
rows.56:2f90:
What? There's nothing in it at all.
And yet Kazama went,{p}
rows.56:3064:
With that thought, I peered in one more time, but the locker was still empty.
Kazama was carefully taking 'something' out of that empty space as if it were precious.
But the shoe locker was empty, I tell you.
There were no shoes, not even indoor shoes.
At least, that's how it looked to me.{p}

"Everyone, why don't we keep Kazama company just a little longer?
I think this is his own way of helping with our interview.
His strange behavior is an act, so that we don't get too tense.
I'm sure of it..."
It wasn't that I wanted to win everyone over for Kazama's sake.
I just wanted to convince myself that it was true.
But everyone's reaction was cold.
"Then why don't you stay here with him by yourself?
We'll go back to the club room ahead of you."
What?{p}W-wait a minute.
rows.56:3440: Leave Kazama and go back first
rows.56:3480:
I can't go along with Kazama's selfishness anymore.
"You can at least open the door yourself."
"Wha-★
You're telling me to open the door myself?
You've got some nerve, saying something so outrageous to someone like me."
...Honestly!
Just because he's a senior, who does he think people are?
How rude can you get.
I'm definitely not doing it!

"You'd better open it."
One of the members muttered it quietly.
"You got here last, so it's only natural you don't know, but...
When he first came here too, he wouldn't come into the room until someone opened the door for him like that."
rows.56:37b4:
"{b}, can you hear me?
Hurry up and open the door for me☆"
Kazama was calling again.
rows.56:3824: As if reacting to his voice and the knocking, the desks began to rattle.{p}
rows.56:3884:
Next, the floor heaved and warped, and pounding on the door and walls rang out.
An earthquake★
No!
It's the sound of knocking.{p}
rows.56:38ec:
"Hurry!
Hurry and open the door☆"
I ran to the door, nearly tripping over myself.
Then I flung the door wide open.
And then...?{p}
rows.56:398c:
The shaking that had been so violent stopped dead.
Outside the door, Kazama stood there with a sulky look on his face.
"Honestly, you've got some nerve, keeping someone like me waiting."
With that, Kazama went straight to his seat and sat down.{p}
rows.56:3a70:
"You're the host, aren't you?
Would you hurry up and move on to the next story?
I've had enough of being kept waiting."
...How selfish can a person be?
He can't even open a door himself, yet he says whatever he likes.
I can't believe a careless person like this has a sixth sense.
Who knows how much of that story he just told was even true.
...But still.
I have to keep all of this to myself.
When I was closing the door, I saw it.
A huge crack running through the club room door...
Just how strong is he?
Let sleeping dogs lie.
It's best not to get involved with people like him.
I'm sure everyone else thinks so too.
Okay, let's move on to the next story before he gets angry.{p}
rows.56:3d60:
"So you'll try opening it.
You've got quite a lot of nerve yourself.
All right, then let's open it.
This shoe locker, right?"{p}
rows.56:3de8:
With that, Kazama reached for the shoe locker...
Ah...{p}...Wait a second!
rows.56:3e40: I've changed my mind, never mind
rows.56:3e64: I'll pick a different shoe locker
rows.56:3e78:
"I've changed my mind!"
I shouted it on the spot.
But it seemed I was a little too late...
Kazama had already flung the shoe locker's door wide open.
Inside it was...★{p}
rows.56:3f40:
A nauseating stench stung my nose.
What a horrible smell!
It smelled like a dead crayfish left in a tank for two or three days.
It seemed kind of musty too.
Could this be the source of the aura swirling in the shoe locker?
If so, it was a monstrously vicious aura, full of hatred.
What do I do...
I can't stop shaking.
I've opened something terrible.
That's how it felt.
Kazama was staring into the shoe locker too, as if glaring at it.
And then, slowly, he closed the door...{p}
rows.56:4118:
"...Phew, that was a truly awful smell.
Who's the one who never washes their shoes?!
Once it gets that bad, it's a crime."
What★
That was the smell of shoes?{p}
rows.56:41b8:
"How truly frightening!
It gives me chills to think someone actually wears shoes like that.
Don't you agree, {b}?"
"............Um, sure."
I mean, that's true, but...{p}
rows.56:425c:
"Well...
Now that we've had a frightening experience, shall we head back to the club room?
Or do you want to try opening another one?"
No way.
I never want to smell anything like that again.{p}
rows.56:430c:
Cursing my bad luck, I hurried to the club room.
Let's see...
Who should I pick next?
Yeah, I'll go with that person.{p}
rows.56:4394:
Back in the club room, once I'd caught my breath, I looked straight into the eyes of the person I'd chosen earlier.
"Now then, the next story, please."{p}
rows.56:4414:
What...
It's just a plain old shoe locker, nothing special about it.
There's only a pair of indoor shoes inside.
...Or so I thought.{p}
rows.56:44a0:

Or else...
Could this be the work of an evil spirit too?

rows.56:4620:
"{b}, it looks like you've had a pretty frightening experience.

"...Yes."

rows.56:46b8:
